name: Tucanos Brazilian Grill (Orem, UT) Churrasco Grilled Picanha (Top Sirloin) & White Rice
brandOrRestaurant: Tucanos Brazilian Grill (Orem / University Place, UT)
whyItWorks: Traditional Brazilian top sirloin roasted on rotisserie skewers with coarse sea salt. Pure, unbreaded, high-iron beef paired with Brazilian white rice and black bean broth.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Request slices of Picanha medium with sea salt; pair with steamed white rice (pass on spicy marinated cuts and raw salad bar onions).
watchOuts: Eat slowly to avoid gastric volume distension from endless skewer service
